answer: Require every agent to lock a deposit and publish a cipher of its planned work before the task is revealed, then reveal the work after a deadline. Honest agents recover the deposit when peers reproduce the same result. A clone army must lock a separate deposit per identity and do distinct committed work, so ten fakes cost ten deposits and ten times the compute. A summit of verifiers checks the reveals, and any answer that merely echo another agent's output without its own matching commit loses its deposit. Doubling the fleet doubles the locked funds, so sybil scale stops paying.
